statements.status_notes: CVE-2026-35172 affects the distribution registry blob storage layer when storage.cache.blobdescriptor uses redis and storage.delete.enabled is true, allowing revoked repo-local blob descriptor reads to return after peer-repo activity. Harbor core does not run the distribution registry or its redis-backed blob storage backend; the bundled Harbor registry component is a separate image (goharbor/registry). harbor-core links distribution/v2 only as a client for manifest parsing and reference handling, so the vulnerable storage code path is never executed.

CVE-2026-33540 affects the distribution registry pull-through cache proxy authentication flow, where credentials can be sent to an attacker-controlled realm URL when an operator configures an upstream registry. Harbor core does not run the distribution pull-through cache proxy. It links the distribution/v2 library only as a client for manifest parsing and reference handling, so the vulnerable server-side proxy code path is never executed.
